name: mxp-platform
description: Money XP (MXP): rule-file driven spend controls and bank-defined missions

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @mxp/server" "npm run dev -w @mxp/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/rules --noEmit && tsc -p packages/platform --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
